Gets the app profile password for a specific device
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/getPasswords

Gets the app profile password for a specific device. You can determine the assigned global passwords by using the username and OS type of a device.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
username
string

Enrolled user for the device.

osType
int32

Device operating system.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
429

OK

*/*

Example (auto)
